description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is hiring a Pricing and Packaging Manager to own how we package, price and sell our products. You will work with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Marketing to make our commercial model easy to buy, easy to expand and fair to customers at every stage of adoption. The role sits in Revenue Operations and reports to the head of that team.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the pricing and packaging strategy across our products, including list prices, tiers, usage metrics, add-ons and enterprise terms. Make the final recommendation on list pricing and packaging.
  • Build and maintain pricing models that link packaging choices to land and expand bookings, average contract value, gross dollar retention and margin. Independently set evaluation criteria and recommend strategic changes based on results.
  • Design packaging for new offerings, including AI-related products, with Product and Product Marketing from concept through launch.
  • Run pricing research and experiments: win/loss analysis, customer interviews, competitive benchmarking and willingness-to-pay studies. Translate findings into clear recommendations.
  • Set discounting and deal-desk guardrails, and review non-standard deals with Sales, Finance and Legal. Approve guardrail changes in partnership with the CRO and CFO.
  • Analyze funnel, pipeline, deal-size and renewal data to find where pricing helps or hurts conversion and expansion. Partner with Sales and Customer Success on adoption-led renewal, upsell and cross-sell strategies.
  • Align pricing with compensation and quota design so incentives reward the deals the packaging is built to produce.
  • Lead through influence across senior stakeholders to align decisions and drive adoption. Keep pricing documentation, quoting rules and billing configuration accurate with operational owners; this work is secondary to strategy and business-outcome ownership.

Qualifications:

  • 12 or more years in pricing, packaging, product strategy, revenue operations, strategy and operations, or a related analytical role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or developer-tools company.
  • Hands-on experience designing pricing for usage-based, seat-based or hybrid models, and for both product-led and sales-led motions.
  • Strong quantitative skills: you build models in spreadsheets or SQL, read funnel and cohort data, and explain trade-offs in plain language.
  • Working knowledge of CRM and quoting data (for example Salesforce) and of how bookings, ARR and retention are measured.
  • Clear writing and presentation skills, and comfort taking a recommendation to executives and the field. Experience influencing executive decisions and leading cross-functional work without direct authority.
  • Curiosity about software delivery and how engineering teams adopt tools, so pricing fits how customers use the product.
  • Nice to have:
    • Experience pricing developer platforms, infrastructure or observability products. Experience pricing AI products, including usage-based or consumption models.
    • Background in sales compensation, deal desk or CPQ and billing systems.
    • Experience running pricing or packaging changes through a customer migration.
    • Familiarity with an experimentation or analytics tool such as LaunchDarkly itself.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 5:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $156,700 - $215,490**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $141,000 - $193,930**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability
